tool_input.description: Probe actual createNumber outputs for edge cases

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/NumberUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (53 test methods, all passing) covering `NumberUtils`: comparisons, all `create*` parsers (including hex/octal/negative/malformed inputs), `createNumber` happy-path and error cases, `isCreatable`/`isNumber`/`isDigits`/`isParsable`, `min`/`max` for all primitive array and 3-arg overloads (plus null/empty-array error cases), `to*` conversions with defaults, `toScaledBigDecimal` overloads, and the public constants/constructor.
